content: A2HS/standalone: installability requires manifest with name/short_name, icons 192+512 PNG, start_url, display: standalone. iOS Add to Home Screen works with NO manifest but opens as a normal Safari tab; manifest display honored iOS ~15.4+; apple-mobile-web-app-capable meta is deprecated (Safari logs a warning) though apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style and apple-touch-icon remain iOS-only levers (apple-touch-icon already present in this repo's index.html). theme-color meta tints mobile browser chrome and needs no manifest.
